```{r}
#| label: setup
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(tidyr)
library(wbstats)
library(ggthemes)

viirs_folder <- "VIIRS Data"
years <- 2015:2020

tif_path <- function(yr) {
  file.path(viirs_folder, yr, sprintf("TKM_VNL_v2_%d_average_masked.tif", yr))
}

tkm_sf <- ne_countries(country = "Turkmenistan", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
tkm <- vect(tkm_sf)

# Close-up windows (lon/lat); also drawn as boxes on the country map
cities <- data.frame(
  name = c("Ashgabat", "Mary", "Türkmenbaşy", "Daşoguz"),
  xmin = c(57.95, 61.40, 52.70, 59.50),
  xmax = c(58.85, 62.30, 53.60, 60.40),
  ymin = c(37.70, 37.35, 39.80, 41.60),
  ymax = c(38.20, 37.85, 40.30, 42.10)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: maps
#| output: asis
read_year <- function(yr) {
  tif_path(yr) |>
    rast() |>
    crop(tkm) |>
    mask(tkm) |>
    as.data.frame(xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) |>
    setNames(c("x", "y", "radiance")) |>
    filter(radiance > 1)
}

lights <- lapply(years, read_year)

#sumlights (full masked raster, not the >1 filtered pixels)
lights_data <- data.frame(
  year = years,
  lights = vapply(years, function(yr) {
    r <- rast(tif_path(yr)) |> crop(tkm) |> mask(tkm)
    global(r, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
  }, numeric(1))
)

#pullwbgdp
gdp_data <- wb_data(
  indicator = c(real_gdp = "NY.GDP.MKTP.KD"), #real GDP adj for inflation
  country = "TKM",
  start_date = min(years),
  end_date = max(years)
) |>
  transmute(year = as.integer(date), real_gdp) |>
  arrange(year)

turkmen_data <- left_join(gdp_data, lights_data, by = "year") |>
  mutate(
    gdp_index = real_gdp / real_gdp[year == 2015] * 100,
    lights_index = lights / lights[year == 2015] * 100
  )

plot_data <- turkmen_data |>
  select(year, `Official GDP` = gdp_index, `Nighttime lights` = lights_index) |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "series", values_to = "index")

#name each line at its right end instead of a legend
line_labels <- filter(plot_data, year == max(year))

turkplot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(year, index, linetype = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = line_labels, aes(label = series),
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.12, family = "serif", size = 5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = years, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    title = "Official GDP vs Nighttime Lights",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_tufte(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif", ticks = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#same chart per year, with the slider's year marked in orange
#11in wide to match the map image, so text renders at the same scale
draw_chart <- function(yr, file) {
  p <- turkplot +
    geom_vline(xintercept = yr, colour = "#e8590c", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = filter(plot_data, year == yr), colour = "#e8590c", size = 4)
  ggsave(file, p, width = 11, height = 4.5, dpi = 170, bg = "white")
}

# Colour tops out at city brightness, so flares don't wash out the towns
base_map <- function(lights_df) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = tkm_sf, fill = "grey93", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_tile(data = lights_df, aes(x, y, fill = radiance)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fcd9b8", high = "#e8590c",
                        trans = "log10", limits = c(1, 60),
                        oob = scales::squish, guide = "none")
}

country_map <- function(lights_df) {
  base_map(lights_df) +
    geom_rect(data = cities, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = cities, aes(xmax, ymax, label = name), hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
              nudge_x = 0.05, family = "serif", size = 4, colour = "grey20") +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void(base_family = "serif") +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
}

city_map <- function(lights_df, city) {
  b <- filter(cities, name == city)
  base_map(filter(lights_df, between(x, b$xmin, b$xmax), between(y, b$ymin, b$ymax))) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(b$xmin, b$xmax), ylim = c(b$ymin, b$ymax), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = city) +
    theme_void(base_family = "serif", base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(colour = "grey20", hjust = 0.5),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
}

draw_year <- function(lights_df, file) {
  png(file, width = 11, height = 11, units = "in", res = 170, bg = "white")
  grid.newpage()
  pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(2, 4, heights = unit(c(7.9, 3.1), "null"))))
  at <- function(p, row, col) print(p, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = row, layout.pos.col = col))
  at(country_map(lights_df), 1, 1:4)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cities))) at(city_map(lights_df, cities$name[i]), 2, i)
  dev.off()
}

map_tags <- vapply(seq_along(years), function(i) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  draw_year(lights[[i]], f)
  sprintf('<img class="ntl-map" data-year="%d" alt="Nighttime lights, %d" src="%s"%s>',
          years[i], years[i], knitr::image_uri(f), if (i == 1) "" else " hidden")
}, character(1))

chart_tags <- vapply(seq_along(years), function(i) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  draw_chart(years[i], f)
  sprintf('<img class="ntl-chart" data-year="%d" alt="GDP vs lights index, %d marked" src="%s"%s>',
          years[i], years[i], knitr::image_uri(f), if (i == 1) "" else " hidden")
}, character(1))

ticks <- paste0("<span>", years, "</span>", collapse = "")

cat(
  "```{=html}",
  '<div class="ntl">',
  sprintf('<div class="ntl-year">%d</div>', min(years)),
  '<div class="ntl-panel">', map_tags, "</div>",
  sprintf('<input type="range" class="ntl-range" min="%d" max="%d" step="1" value="%d" aria-label="Year">',
          min(years), max(years), min(years)),
  sprintf('<div class="ntl-ticks">%s</div>', ticks),
  '<div class="ntl-panel ntl-chart-panel">', chart_tags, "</div>",
  "</div>",
  "```",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

```{=html}
<style>
.ntl { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
.ntl-year { font-family: serif; font-size: 1.6rem; text-align: center; color: #444; }
.ntl-map, .ntl-chart { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.ntl-chart-panel { margin-top: 2rem; }
.ntl-panel img[hidden] { display: none; }
.ntl-range { width: 100%; accent-color: #e8590c; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.ntl-ticks { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: serif;
             font-size: 0.85rem; color: #666; }
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.ntl').forEach(box => {
  const range = box.querySelector('.ntl-range');
  const label = box.querySelector('.ntl-year');
  const maps = box.querySelectorAll('img[data-year]');
  const show = () => {
    maps.forEach(m => { m.hidden = m.dataset.year !== range.value; });
    label.textContent = range.value;
  };
  range.addEventListener('input', show);
  show();
});
</script>
```
